policy_text_full: IHG's Best Price Guarantee matches a lower publicly available rate within 24 hours of booking. IHG One Rewards membership is required. Bonus: free first night OR 5x base points. Some regions enforce a 48-hour pre-arrival cutoff in addition to the 24-hour booking window.
policy_text_relevant_clause: Within 24 hours of booking, IHG One Rewards members can claim BPG; regional 48-hour pre-arrival rule may apply in some markets.
